bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
SOURCE_SHA=9a9485d30480746a4c0676a3eebf44cfabb975cf
RUN_ID=44581359279
ROOT="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/offline-artifacts/$SOURCE_SHA"
mkdir -p "$ROOT"
printf 'VIDEO_IMAGE_STAGING_START\\n'
if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'GH_CLI_UNAVAILABLE'; exit 70; fi
if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'DOCKER_UNAVAILABLE'; exit 71; fi
if [ ! -f "$ROOT/create-videobot-image.tar.gz" ]; then
  gh run download "$RUN_ID" --repo seigo-gace/create-videobot --name "create-videobot-offline-$SOURCE_SHA" --dir "$ROOT"
fi
cd "$ROOT"
sha256sum -c create-videobot-image.tar.gz.sha256 >/dev/null
printf 'IMAGE_ARCHIVE_CHECKSUM=PASS\\n'
gzip -dc create-videobot-image.tar.gz | docker load >/dev/null
printf 'IMAGE_LOADED_ID='
docker image inspect create-videobot:local-telegram --format '{{.Id}}'
printf 'ACTIVE_POLL_UNCHANGED_IMAGE='
docker inspect gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 --format '{{.Image}}'
printf 'STAGED_IMAGE_SOURCE_SHA=%s\\n' "$SOURCE_SHA"
